summary:
A seasoned professional with nearly five years of experience in procurement, specializing in purchase,
sourcing, and operational management. Proven expertise in vendor negotiation, market price analysis,
and inventory management across diverse industries including FMCG, furniture, and pharmaceuticals.
Highly skilled in using SAP-ERP, Dynamics 365 Business Central, ERP-LN and Order Management Systems
to streamline processes and drive efficiency. Seeking to leverage strong leadership and analytical skills to
enhance operational performance and contribute to organizational growth.
